card.name: Unit nouns after a quantity
card.fires_on: The noun that names a unit or measure right after a number or fraction, such as crop, orders, taka, field, level, sprays, order, percentage. It sits before a following 'of' or 'per' phrase.

modes.label: Measure nouns before 'of'
modes.description: A counting noun after a number or fraction, then 'of' follows.
modes.example: 18<< orders>> of magnitude on the temporal scale

modes.label: Currency and size units
modes.description: The end of a unit such as taka, or football field, after a number.

modes.label: Dose and spray counts
modes.description: A counted dose item such as sprays or dose level after a number.
modes.example: is one or two spr<<ays>> per nostril twice daily

card.plain: It fires on the unit word that follows a number, like 'orders' in '18 orders of magnitude' or 'taka' after an amount.
